title: 第710 章 啸山告知第 709章 恐怖的虚灵虫
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：残鼎复元：陆家修仙崛起路第一卷：默认第710章啸山告知（..la）陆行舟与啸山缓步前行，生怕没收住灵力，引来虚灵虫的注意。
沿途地面上，偶有散落的残破的碎片和枯骨，显然过往也有修士和妖兽在此遭了毒手。
一个时辰后，两人终于走出了那片黑色密林，来到一处荒山脚下。
陆行舟催动灵目仔细查探四周，确认没有虚灵虫的踪迹，才长长地松了一口气。
他看向身旁警惕的啸山，拱手道：“啸道友，这里已安全了，你可以放心。”
啸山重重呼出一口浊气，朝着陆行舟郑重拱手，语气诚恳：“多谢道友救命之恩，啸某欠你一条命，日后若有差遣，定当全力相报。”
陆行舟摆了摆手：“道友不必如此，你只需告诉我秘境之中，何处能获得火属性的灵物便可，普通的就不用说了。”
啸山没有多想，抬手指向西边：“往西走，穿过一片黄沙之地和一处山谷，那里有一座火山，地火旺盛，应当能找到你需要的火属性灵物。”
他说着，忽然压低了声音，神色变得谨慎起来：“不过……我劝道友还是莫要去，那边被金焰一族给霸占了，但凡有修士靠近，都会被灭杀，霸道至极，每次进入的金焰一族修士修为不仅都是元婴后期，他们还擅长御火，在火山地带战力倍增，同阶修士对上它们几乎毫无胜算。”
陆行舟闻言，心中一喜，终于有火山位置的消息了。
他脑海中忽然浮现此前偶遇的那名金袍妖修身影，心中隐隐有了几分猜测，想来那金袍修士，便是金焰一族的族人。
他微微点头，拱手道谢：“多谢道友如实相告，在下去外围看看，若是不行再去其他地方寻找，道友保重，后会有期。”
话音落下，他不再多做停留，身形一晃，化作一道流光，径直朝着西方火山所在的方向疾驰而去。
啸山望着他消失的背影，摇了摇头，低声自语：“我已如实告知，也算还了对方救命的人情，此人还要前往送死，那就不关我的事了。”
他低头看了看自己空荡荡的腰腹和指尖，苦笑一声。
如今他身上法宝、储物戒尽数被虚灵虫啃噬报废，一身家当荡然无存，在这危机四伏的秘境之中，别说争抢机缘，就连自保尚且勉强。
他不再犹豫，转身朝着秘境出口的方向遁去，打算直接离开这个凶险之地。
另一边，陆行舟全速遁行，翻过荒山，避开沿途的争斗和妖兽，一路横穿苍茫黄沙古原。
此地万里黄沙，燥热气浪翻涌，时不时会有一群低阶毒蝎在细沙中穿梭。
他原本以为此处会有其他高阶妖兽，可一路前行，除了碰到几波游荡的低阶虫群，并未有其他，这也让他省下不少麻烦。

经过十余天的赶路，他终于抵达了啸山所言的山谷之外。
陆行舟悬停在半空，神识铺开探入到山谷之内。
谷内一片荒芜，没人任何灵植，看上去并无异样。
他正欲踏入谷中，忽然察觉远处传来一丝极细微的灵力波动，正从侧后方快速接近。
陆行舟心中一凛，连忙收敛全身气息，周身灵光一闪，迅速沉入地下数十丈深，屏息凝神，用隐灵纱盖住自己。
片刻后，两道遁光落在山谷入口处，光华散去，露出两名修士的身影，一男一女，皆是元婴后期的修为。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: The Restoration of the Broken Cauldron: The Road to the Lu Family’s Rise to Immortality Volume 1: Default Chapter 710 Xiaoshan Informed (..la) Lu Xingzhou and Xiaoshan walked forward slowly, for fear of confiscating their spiritual power and attracting the attention of the Void Spirit Insect.
On the ground along the way, there were occasionally broken fragments and dead bones scattered. It was obvious that monks and monsters had been poisoned here in the past.
An hour later, the two finally walked out of the dark forest and arrived at the foot of a barren mountain.
Lu Xingzhou urged his spiritual eyes to carefully examine the surroundings. After confirming that there was no trace of the Void Spirit Insect, he breathed a long sigh of relief.
He looked at the vigilant Xiao Shan beside him, cupped his hands and said, "Fellow Taoist Xiao, it's safe here, you can rest assured."
Xiaoshan exhaled a heavy breath, solemnly raised his hands to Lu Xingzhou, and said in a sincere tone: "Thank you Taoist fellow Taoist for saving your life. Xiaoshan owes you a life. If I have to do anything in the future, I will repay you with all my strength."
Lu Xingzhou waved his hand: "You don't have to be like this, fellow Taoist. All you need to do is tell me where to get fire-attributed spiritual objects in the secret realm. There's no need to tell me about ordinary ones."
Xiao Shan didn't think much, raised his hand and pointed to the west: "Go west, pass through a land of yellow sand and a valley. There is a volcano there with strong earth fire. You should be able to find the fire attribute spiritual object you need."
As he spoke, he suddenly lowered his voice and his expression became cautious: "However... I advise fellow Taoists not to go there. It is occupied by the Golden Flame Clan. Any monks who come near will be killed. They are extremely overbearing. Every time the monks of the Golden Flame Clan enter are not only in the late Nascent Soul stage, they are also good at controlling fire. Their combat power is doubled in volcanic areas. Monks of the same level have almost no chance of winning against them."
When Lu Xingzhou heard this, he felt happy. Finally, there was news about the location of the volcano.
The figure of the golden-robed demon cultivator he met by chance suddenly appeared in his mind, and he had some vague guesses in his mind. He thought that the golden-robed cultivator was a member of the Jinyan clan.
He nodded slightly, cupped his hands and said thanks: "Thank you, fellow Taoist, for telling the truth. I'll go and have a look outside. If it doesn't work, I'll look elsewhere. Take care, fellow Taoist. See you later."
As soon as he finished speaking, he didn't stop any longer. He swayed and turned into a stream of light, speeding straight towards the direction of the volcano in the west.
Xiaoshan looked at his disappearing back, shook his head, and whispered to himself: "I have told the truth truthfully, and I have repaid the other person's favor for saving his life. If this person wants to go to die, then it is none of my business."
He looked down at his empty waist and fingertips, and smiled bitterly.
Now, all the magic weapons and storage rings on his body have been eaten by ethereal insects and scrapped, and all his belongings are gone. In this dangerous secret realm, let alone fighting for opportunities, he can barely protect himself.
He no longer hesitated, turned around and fled towards the exit of the secret realm, intending to leave this dangerous place directly.
On the other side, Lu Xingzhou fled at full speed, crossing the barren mountains, avoiding fights and monsters along the way, and crossing the vast ancient plains of yellow sand.
This place has thousands of miles of yellow sand, and the hot air waves are surging. From time to time, a group of low-level poisonous scorpions will shuttle through the fine sand.
He originally thought that there would be other high-level monsters here, but along the way, except for a few waves of wandering low-level insect swarms, there was nothing else, which also saved him a lot of trouble.
After more than ten days of traveling, he finally arrived outside the valley that Xiaoshan mentioned.
Lu Xingzhou hovered in mid-air, his consciousness spreading out and reaching into the valley.
The valley was deserted, no one had any spiritual plants, and it looked nothing out of the ordinary.
He was about to step into the valley when he suddenly noticed a very subtle fluctuation of spiritual power coming from the distance, approaching quickly from the side and behind.
Lu Xingzhou's heart trembled, and he quickly gathered his aura. A flash of light flashed around his body, and he quickly sank dozens of feet underground. He held his breath and concentrated, covering himself with the hidden spirit gauze.
After a moment, two rays of light fell at the entrance of the valley, and the light dispersed, revealing the figures of two monks, one male and one female, both of whom were in the late Nascent Soul.
